page: Microsoft Azure M128bs_v3 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the MBSMediumMemoryv3 family. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs derived from 64 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8473C processor running at 4.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It lacks local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on external block storage and premium storage options.

Benchmark results indicate exceptional memory performance, with cached read bandwidth reaching 9026.27 GB/sec and uncached read bandwidth at 433.45 GB/sec, both placing in the top 10% tier. Multi-threaded operations are highly efficient, as evidenced by top-tier bzip3 decompression and a strong multi-core Geekbench score. Database operations and Redis SET throughput of 138.25 million operations per second also rank in the top tier, supported by advanced CPU instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel AMX for matrix operations.

Given its high resource density and massive memory capacity, the server offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound enterprise applications, though the lack of local NVMe storage means all disk I/O must traverse the network to block storage. This configuration is highly suited for large-scale in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, heavy database operations, and memory-intensive enterprise workloads.
